'''Xizor's navy''' referred to the personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate leader [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. The fleet was centrally located over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Most notably, the fleet participated in the [[Battle over Coruscant]], which saw Xizor's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].
